page_title_content.title: Commit to community
page_title_content.description: It’s more than just a value written on our site. It’s how we show up for organizations making a difference in our area. We encourage a culture that promotes diversity, equity, and inclusion inside the company and within our communities.

introduction.title: O3 gives back
introduction.description: We believe in the importance of giving back to the community and that drives us to devote countless hours to mentorship and volunteering. Here are some of the organizations we're proud to partner with:

accordion.text_editor: Be the change you seek in the world by sharing your enthusiasm, positivity, and good nature — one person at a time.
Assume positive intent by always treating others the way you would want to be treated — which includes the openness to have respectful, constructive dialogue.
Focus on values and culture alignment that promote diversity, equity, and inclusion inside the company and within our communities.
Believe in a world where opportunity for continuous improvement requires a strong sense of flexibility and willingness to grow from yourself and those around you.
Rally ourselves and our clients to focus on what’s next by pushing boundaries and staying on the cutting edge.
